agent.name: hubspot-contact-reporter
agent.goal: Read HubSpot contacts on request and write a local JSON report.

acquisition_paths.label: HubSpot connection server (broker-backed)
acquisition_paths.how: Not available yet — no connection server exists to authorize against.
acquisition_paths.reuse: Planned: authorize once against the connection server; chat dry-runs, Cursor and the deployed agent then all use that one connection.
acquisition_paths.caveat: Needs someone to operate the verified provider OAuth app (directly or via a broker). MAR-383; until it ships, use the actionable path below.

acquisition_paths.label: HubSpot MCP server (community)
acquisition_paths.how: Install and authorize the community MCP server, then point this agent at it. The server holds the provider token; the agent only calls the server.
acquisition_paths.reuse: Any MCP client you point at this server reuses it, but each client still connects to the server itself — the provider grant is never copied between applications.
acquisition_paths.caveat: No official server here — community packages vary in quality and hold a live token, so review one before trusting it.

acquisition_paths.label: HubSpot direct credentials (scripts/connect.mjs)
acquisition_paths.how: Run `node scripts/connect.mjs`: it opens the Private App token (HubSpot, read scope) / OAuth2 (Salesforce) flow, live-probes the credential and writes the agent's local .env.
acquisition_paths.reuse: Serves this agent only — another app, or another copy of this agent, authorizes again.
acquisition_paths.caveat: You operate the provider app yourself, including any verification it requires.
